item.title: All Things Go 2026: Here’s Where to Shop Affordable Music Festival Tickets Online
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[INTRO MUSIC FADES OUT]
Host: "Welcome back to [PODCAST NAME]! As summer festival season comes to a close, we're excited to talk about the All Things Go Festival, happening in not one, but two cities on the East Coast. From September 25th to 27th, you can catch this amazing festival in New York City's Forest Hills Stadium in Queens, and at Merriweather Post Pavilion in Columbia, Maryland, also known as the DMV."
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "So, who's performing? In New York City, you can expect to see Zara Larsson, Lola Young, comedian Meg Stalter, The Beaches, Carly Rae Jepsen, and many more. Meanwhile, in the DMV, the lineup includes Mitski, Ethel Cain, comedian Robby Hoffman, Rico Nasty, Hayley Williams, and She & Him, among others. And, of course, the one and only Brandi Carlile is scheduled to headline both locations."
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "Now, about tickets. They initially went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster, but many dates have already sold out or are close to selling out. If you're still looking for tickets, you can try third-party sites like StubHub, SeatGeek, Vivid Seats, and more. These sites guarantee authentic tickets, and prices may vary above or below face value."
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "If you're looking for the best deals, we recommend checking out StubHub, SeatGeek, and Vivid Seats. As of now, tickets start at around $90 to $100. And, if you use our discount code BILLBOARD10 at SeatGeek, you can even save an extra $10 at checkout."
[OUTRO MUSIC FADES IN]
Host: "That's all for today, folks! If you're interested in attending the All Things Go Festival, be sure to check out those ticket links and get ready for an unforgettable experience. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[OUTRO MUSIC CONTINUES TO PLAY UNTIL THE END]
